sources.supports: Lists Broadway Run North and Broadway Run South as public Big Wood River water-access sites for fishing and walking.
Identifies Broadway Run Road as the take-out for the Ketchum Rotary Park to Broadway Run reach.
Confirms the Broadway Run Road/SH-75 corridor and Big Wood River crossing context.

sourceAssessment: County recreation inventory and the named river-run record independently document Broadway Run as the public access/take-out corridor. Retain the stored point as a conditional access-area anchor.
